title: Close common-flag workspace exclusions with designated data cuts
body:
The common-flag circuit bounds in PR825/PR1757 retain an all-role permutation contract. This contribution closes their clean-input and changing-width exclusions: the same outgoing-transcript argument proves `s >= Wm` for W independent designated data demands, even with local clean allocation, copying, erasure and unconstrained dirty garbage. It is an explicitly credited contract corollary, not a new cut principle or nonlinear-gate result.

The independence boundary matters. A data-dependent copy preloaded at another frame can satisfy the designated endpoint at rank bill zero. The package executes this counterexample, distinguishes it from copies created inside the fully charged DAG, and checks that three copies of one transported input remain one independent demand. Every physical wire is charged and all ports of a gate share one frame.

The independent DAG checker evaluates262 finite examples, including all256 three-input Boolean scratch functions on every input. Full replay covers2,066 input assignments,65,984 binary vertex partitions and1,047,516 outside-only reconstructions. It retains physical fan-out port multiplicity and includes nonlinear/clean/erasure examples outside the old full-permutation interface. Eight semantic controls and three actual file-corruption controls pass, including a nonlinear endpoint that fools zero/one-hot tests. Finite checks corroborate the written corollary; they do not enumerate all circuits.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/common-flag-disposable-workspace
python3.12 -I -O -B research/common-flag-disposable-workspace/verify.py
```

Registered CPython3.12.7 replay and a Git-free export pass. Separate AI review checks the written proof and physical-port implementation. No hosted CI, human review, proof-kernel verification or selected cold replay is claimed.

Only `research/common-flag-disposable-workspace/` is added. This rules out changing only workspace lifecycle within the common-flag all-wire model and independent-data normalization. It does not resolve PR2167's arbitrary clean-ancilla rational group-algebra question, admit free different-frame COPY in the selected stream, provide physical lowering or improve kappa.

Base main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision4, was refreshed before submission. Exact unchanged predecessor inputs are pinned. Complete retained overlap comprises683 open PRs at12:29:40UTC and1,197 Discussion records at12:29UTC on2026-10-15. GraphQL rate limiting prevented a complete new Discussion refresh; bounded fresh REST PR/head/comment checks and a direct CuriosityBot read of Discussion1753 supplement it. Coverage limits and comparisons are explicit in OVERLAP.md.

Credit Navinor/PR825, Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml)/PR1757, the retained finite-shear source and preceding audits. The next question is a complete copied-stream DAG outside common-flag geometry, with all wires and physical conversion accounted for. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI review; Apache-2.0. Predecessors and selected record remain unchanged.
